goalsWithHint: The goals {{who}} set for you and how they are progressing.
goalsForHint: The goals you set for {{who}} and how they are progressing.
myGoalsHint: The goals your managers set for you, across all of them.
managedGoalsHint: The goals you've set for your reports. Switch Reports to also include goals set further down your chain.
createHint: Pick the team member and define the goal. It starts as a draft — activate it when it should go live.
title: Title
typeChangeWarning: Changing the goal type resets its target and recorded progress.
closeMessage: Archiving records the goal as finished, with a summary of how it went. You can reopen it later if needed.
summaryRequired: A summary is required to archive a goal
discardMessage: Discard changes? The goal will stay as it was.
activatePromptQuestion: Do you want to activate the goal immediately?
deleteMessage: The goal will disappear from all lists; its history is retained. This cannot be undone.

validation.titleTooLong: The title must be at most {{max}} characters
validation.descriptionTooLong: The description must be at most {{max}} characters
validation.targetRequired: A target value is required for this goal type
validation.percentageRange: A percentage must be between 0 and 100
validation.dueDateInPast: The due date cannot be in the past

error.notFound: This goal does not exist or was deleted.
error.viewPermission: You may not view this goal.
error.savePermission: Only the goal's manager may change it.
error.conflict: The goal's status changed in the meantime — reload and try again.
error.invalid: The goal could not be saved — check the fields and try again.
error.invalidTransition: This action is not available in the goal's current status.
error.createForbidden: You may only set goals for your direct reports.
error.activateAfterCreateFailed: The goal was created as a draft, but activating it failed — you can activate it from its view.
error.activateOverdue: The goal's due date has passed — set a new due date before activating.

goalsAuditHint: Every goal {{who}} is a party to — as manager or team member — at every status. Read-only.
